property_summary: A call to Collect cannot change MinSum (MinSum after the call equals MinSum before the call) because Collect's external call cannot reenter SetMinSum under the original nonReentrant_ guard.

Invariant: After any call to Collect by an account, MinSum remains unchanged (reference enforces nonReentrant via require so Collect cannot be reentered to change MinSum); the mutant removing the require allows a reentrant attacker to call SetMinSum during Collect and thus change MinSum.

For any inputs, calling Collect from an attacker that re-enters cannot change MinSum in the reference (nonReentrant_ prevents reentrancy), but the mutant (which removes the require) allows a reentrant attacker to call SetMinSum during Collect and thus change MinSum for some inputs.

For every admissible attacker-provided deposit and unlockTime, invoking Collect cannot result in a change to MinSum on the reference contract (nonReentrant_'s require blocks reentrant SetMinSum), but the mutant that removes the require allows a reentrant attacker to call SetMinSum during Collect and thus can change MinSum for some inputs.

For all attacker deposit amounts and attempted collect amounts, calling Collect from a re-entrant attacker cannot change C.MinSum() on the reference (nonReentrant_ prevents reentrant SetMinSum), but the mutant (which removes the require check) allows a reentrant attacker to call SetMinSum during Collect and thus can change MinSum for some fuzzed inputs.

For any attacker deposit and collect amount, attempting a Collect() call from a reentrant attacker cannot change C.MinSum() in the reference (the nonReentrant_ modifier's require prevents reentrancy), while the mutant that removes the require allows a reentrant attacker to call SetMinSum during Collect and thereby change MinSum for some fuzzed inputs.
Once Initialized() has been called, SetMinSum must revert (i.e., cannot change MinSum); the mutant removed that revert allowing MinSum to be changed after initialization.

After calling Initialized(), SetMinSum(uint) must revert (i.e., cannot change MinSum) for every input on the reference; the mutant removed that revert allowing MinSum to be changed after initialization.
